summary: This bill directs the Secretary of Housing and Urban Development to establish a hotline within one year to provide assistance with eviction-related matters for tenants in federally assisted rental dwelling units.

scores.thoughts: The bill authorizes appropriations for the establishment and operation of an eviction helpline, indicating an increase in government spending to fund this new service.

The bill aims to establish a hotline providing eviction-related assistance to tenants in federally assisted housing, which expands support services for vulnerable populations and thus strengthens the social safety net.
